dhp383:0.3: The word _Brāhmaṇa_, in addition to being the title of the hereditary priest caste, is also used by the Buddha to indicate an advanced spiritual practitioner regardless of their caste, and is often used to indicate a person who has attained some stage of awakening.
dhp387:6: _Tejas_ (lit. “heat, fire”) also can mean splendor, glory, and power (especially spiritual power or psychic power).
dhp388:1: Each line is a wordplay. Here the wordplay is that a _brāhmaṇa_ (brahmin) has _bāhita_ (expelled) all evil.
